main.title: Gospellist
main.sub_title: Gospellist is a non-profit organization dedicated to developing and distributing Bible apps.

section1.title: Our Mission
text: Our mission is to create and share Bible apps that help seekers, non-believers, and believers around the world engage with Scripture daily. We believe that when people encounter God’s Word each day, lives are transformed.
To fulfill this mission, we have already built strong capabilities in Bible app development and are actively working on new projects to meet the needs of a global audience.

section2.title: Empowering Underprivileged Youth
text: We are also committed to training young people from underprivileged communities to become skilled app developers. By sharing our experience and knowledge in Bible app development, we provide these youth with real learning opportunities—and real work. They are not only trained but also given projects, enabling them to participate in app development and build a path toward economic self-reliance.

section3.title: Supporting Digital Evangelism Worldwide
text: Before founding this organization, our core members were already engaged in developing Bible apps and supporting digital evangelism teams in the Middle East. Now, we are expanding this work to support digital mission teams across the globe—providing tools, training, and spiritual resources to help them share the Gospel effectively in the digital age.

section4.title: We Do This Together—with Gospellists
section4.text_head: We believe that this mission is carried out together with Gospellists from all walks of life:
text: Missionaries and Pastors who share the apps,
And Bible readers who live out the Word each day.

main.title: Our Church Malsseum Simbang
main.sub_title: A Bible app personalized for each church and each person, also distributed as Shalom Script (English) and Kitab Al-Salam (Arabic).
text: The idea for Our Church Malsseum Simbang was born out of a recurring challenge in digital evangelism: many seekers and non-believers respond to online gospel ads and request a Bible—but soon disappear without receiving proper follow-up from evangelism teams.

In addition, in many regions, it is still uncommon for church members to read and meditate on the Bible daily. Our Church Malsseum Simbang encourages and enables both seekers and believers to engage with Scripture every day.

features.title: Fully Personalized Bible Reading Plans
features.desc: Tailored plans for individual users and churches, starting on chosen dates.

features.title: Pastor-Branded Commentary
features.desc: Daily commentary aligned with Protestant doctrine, editable or recordable by pastors, with options for anonymity in sensitive areas.

features.title: Automated Daily Content Delivery
features.desc: Mobile notifications deliver Scripture and commentary seamlessly each day.

features.title: Accessible Text and Audio Format
features.desc: Content available in text and audio, leveraging FCBH resources for global reach.

features.title: Questions and AI-Recommended Answers
features.desc: AI handles initial responses, linking apologetics content, with team oversight to ensure care and engagement.

features.title: Tablet of My Heart Meditation and Journaling – A Personal Meditation Space
features.desc: Users save verses, write reflections, and keep a lifelong archive of spiritual journaling.

features.title: Care Information
features.desc: Pastors and missionaries gain insights into user engagement for better discipleship and follow-up.

target_users.title: Seekers and Non-Believers
target_users.desc: Replace printed Bibles with app-based daily content and care, scaling with partner teams’ vision to reach 100 million people by 2030.

target_users.title: Church Members
target_users.desc: Churches design and distribute custom reading plans, fostering daily Scripture reading culture.

items.name: Family Ministry
summary: Many wives are beaten by their husbands. Many wives are abandoned by their husbands.
This still happens in many countries.
Father School must enter these countries. Mother School must enter these countries.
We take on the work that comes before and after Father School and Mother School enter.
detail: We want to confront the problem of beaten and abandoned wives head-on.
This is Father School and Mother School for Muslims.
It is dangerous and the barriers are high, so it requires great wisdom and cooperation.
Over the past 10 years we have opened and supported Father Schools and Mother Schools in the Middle East and helped local ministry teams become self-reliant.
Drawing on this experience, wisdom and network of partners, we carry out this difficult ministry to Muslim families, asking for God's special guidance and protection.

items.name: Livelihood Ministry
summary: We grieve that young people in poor countries cannot find work and remain unemployed.
We want to give each of them a computer and teach them how to build apps, which is what we do best.
We want to raise them as software developers so that they can earn their own living.
detail: We want to teach underprivileged young people in the Middle East how to develop software with AI coding, focusing our guidance on the parts that need a human touch.
We have built many pieces of software, including Our Church Malsseum Simbang. Our mission is to share this experience and raise them as software developers.
Our ministry model does not end with teaching: through ongoing mentorship, we help them become self-reliant.

items.name: Digital Evangelism
summary: We have compassion for people who have never heard the gospel and do not know Jesus.
We want to share the gospel with them through digital advertising evangelism, either directly or by supporting others.
When we run gospel ads, the Holy Spirit leads people to see them, respond, receive Jesus and request a Bible. The numbers are astonishing.
We want to send the names of the souls the Holy Spirit has led to believers in Korean churches and ask them to pray. Then you can become a channel of blessing, as described in Genesis 12:3.
detail: We want to support digital evangelism teams and increase the fruit of their outreach.
Through years of digital ministry, we developed the “Sustained Digital Evangelism Model through Bible Meditation Care” (presented at KMQ, KMQ English, GMLF and elsewhere).

This model works well with the Our Church Malsseum Simbang app (Shalom Script in English, Kitab Al-Salam in Arabic). Alongside the app, we focus on raising evangelism outcomes, including second-stage evangelism.

items.name: Bible App Development & Distribution
summary: We grieve that seekers, converts and believers on the mission field struggle to read the Bible.
The reasons include oral culture, illiteracy, the difficulty of the Bible's script and more. We have experience solving these problems and distributing personalized Bibles to them.
We want to distribute this personalized Bible app to Korean churches and to seekers, converts and believers in the Arabic-speaking world.

The Bible app for Korean churches is called “Our Church Malsseum Simbang.” It is personalized for each church and each person, and we support every pastor in visiting their whole congregation and each member with the Word that fits them.
detail: The Our Church Malsseum Simbang app we develop can become a source of funding for our organization.
Korean churches use the Bible app we provide, and we can receive the usage fee as an offering or a subscription.
This income can then cover the costs of the ministries described above.
If the app is used widely in Korean churches, we can become financially self-sufficient.
